mapper.sql: , author_relation AS ( SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(achievement_link.canonical_entity_id, relation_value.achievement_id) AS achievement_id, COALESCE(author_link.canonical_entity_id, relation_value.author_id) AS author_id FROM achievement_author relation_value LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link achievement_link ON achievement_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND achievement_link.entity_id = relation_value.achievement_id LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link author_link ON author_link.entity_type = 'AUTHOR' AND author_link.entity_id = relation_value.author_id )

, organization_relation AS ( SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(achievement_link.canonical_entity_id, relation_value.achievement_id) AS achievement_id, COALESCE(organization_link.canonical_entity_id, relation_value.organization_id) AS organization_id FROM authorship_organization relation_value LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link achievement_link ON achievement_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND achievement_link.entity_id = relation_value.achievement_id LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link organization_link ON organization_link.entity_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND organization_link.entity_id = relation_value.organization_id )

, source_relation AS ( SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(achievement_link.canonical_entity_id, relation_value.achievement_id) AS achievement_id, relation_value.source_id FROM achievement_source relation_value LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link achievement_link ON achievement_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND achievement_link.entity_id = relation_value.achievement_id )

, topic_relation AS ( SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(achievement_link.canonical_entity_id, relation_value.achievement_id) AS achievement_id, relation_value.subject_id FROM achievement_subject relation_value LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link achievement_link ON achievement_link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND achievement_link.entity_id = relation_value.achievement_id )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT scoped.id) AS achievement_count, COUNT(DISTINCT authors.author_id) AS author_count, COUNT(DISTINCT organizations.organization_id) AS organization_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sources.source_id) AS source_count FROM scoped_achievement scoped LEFT JOIN author_relation authors ON authors.achievement_id = scoped.id LEFT JOIN organization_relation organizations ON organizations.achievement_id = scoped.id LEFT JOIN source_relation sources ON sources.achievement_id = scoped.id
SELECT publication_year, COUNT(*) AS achievement_count FROM scoped_achievement WHERE publication_year IS NOT NULL GROUP BY publication_year ORDER BY publication_year

SELECT COALESCE(achievement_type, 'UNKNOWN') AS item_key, COALESCE(achievement_type, '未知') AS item_label, COUNT(*) AS achievement_count FROM scoped_achievement GROUP BY achievement_type ORDER BY achievement_count DESC, item_key

SELECT source_value.source_code AS item_key, source_value.source_code AS item_label, COUNT(DISTINCT scoped.id) AS achievement_count FROM scoped_achievement scoped JOIN source_relation relation_value ON relation_value.achievement_id = scoped.id JOIN data_source source_value ON source_value.id = relation_value.source_id GROUP BY source_value.id, source_value.source_code ORDER BY achievement_count DESC, item_key

SELECT CAST(organization.id AS CHAR) AS item_key, COALESCE(organization.display_name, CONCAT('机构 ', organization.id)) AS item_label, COUNT(DISTINCT scoped.id) AS achievement_count FROM scoped_achievement scoped JOIN organization_relation relation_value ON relation_value.achievement_id = scoped.id JOIN organization ON organization.id = relation_value.organization_id GROUP BY organization.id, organization.display_name ORDER BY achievement_count DESC, organization.id LIMIT 20

SELECT CAST(subject.id AS CHAR) AS item_key, subject.display_name AS item_label, COUNT(DISTINCT scoped.id) AS achievement_count FROM scoped_achievement scoped JOIN topic_relation relation_value ON relation_value.achievement_id = scoped.id JOIN subject ON subject.id = relation_value.subject_id GROUP BY subject.id, subject.display_name ORDER BY achievement_count DESC, subject.id LIMIT 20

SELECT left_author.id AS left_id, COALESCE(left_author.display_name, CONCAT('作者 ', left_author.id)) AS left_label, right_author.id AS right_id, COALESCE(right_author.display_name, CONCAT('作者 ', right_author.id)) AS right_label, COUNT(DISTINCT scoped.id) AS shared_achievement_count FROM scoped_achievement scoped JOIN author_relation left_relation ON left_relation.achievement_id = scoped.id JOIN author_relation right_relation ON right_relation.achievement_id = scoped.id AND right_relation.author_id > left_relation.author_id JOIN author left_author ON left_author.id = left_relation.author_id JOIN author right_author ON right_author.id = right_relation.author_id GROUP BY left_author.id, left_author.display_name, right_author.id, right_author.display_name ORDER BY shared_achievement_count DESC, left_author.id, right_author.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT left_organization.id AS left_id, COALESCE(left_organization.display_name, CONCAT('机构 ', left_organization.id)) AS left_label, right_organization.id AS right_id, COALESCE(right_organization.display_name, CONCAT('机构 ', right_organization.id)) AS right_label, COUNT(DISTINCT scoped.id) AS shared_achievement_count FROM scoped_achievement scoped JOIN organization_relation left_relation ON left_relation.achievement_id = scoped.id JOIN organization_relation right_relation ON right_relation.achievement_id = scoped.id AND right_relation.organization_id > left_relation.organization_id JOIN organization left_organization ON left_organization.id = left_relation.organization_id JOIN organization right_organization ON right_organization.id = right_relation.organization_id GROUP BY left_organization.id, left_organization.display_name, right_organization.id, right_organization.display_name ORDER BY shared_achievement_count DESC, left_organization.id, right_organization.id LIMIT #{limit}
